description:
Aggregate the work that turns every validation view and built-in validation gate checker into a selection of the one report.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Whole, per-issue, scope, rule and explain validation select from one report computed from one capture; only whole validation and the repository-validation checker read event-log history and gate runs.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each built-in validation checker reports what `jit validate` reports for its selection.
- [hard] REQ-03: One property test owns the selection contract.
- [hard] REQ-04: No executor-side validation pass copy or checker pipeline remains, and nothing under the validation layer names `commands`.
title: Every validation view is a selection of the report
